review.name: Worldstorm Dragon
findings: Original frozen complete-face patches detect released brow, muzzle, chin, side jaw and crest drift. Four fitted leg chains and coordinated actions now preserve the sculpt, textures, all original 21 bone frames and inverse binds, and unrelated authored head/neck/tail curves. All twelve candidate source slices and 216 actual equipped technique frames actually inspected and pass. Frozen sole samples 559/539/456/435 retain support within 0.000211 over 481 times per action; both front paws lift 0.035 in the attack and the hind paws support. Cast and recoil retain four supports. Original standing attack sole drift reached 0.3879 despite zero head/neck sole weights. Separate rebuilt battle and final repeat review pending.

Final second pass actually inspected all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, all 32 production transition slices at low/medium, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 native actual equipped-technique frames in twelve lossless strips, and sixteen atlas cells. All pass. Source and battle each pass 485 full-geometry poses and 468 independent face blends. Original sculpt, UVs, textures, all original bone frames/inverses retained. Complete-face binding repair plus four fitted limb chains, five gait passes and three coordinated actions. Fourteen regression/animation-bank tests and production build pass. Whole-roster/main/live verification still pending.

freshVisualFirstPass.label: independent-mythic-000-005-baseline-source
freshVisualFirstPass.finding: Muzzle, lower jaw and crest shift under secondary idle, head turns, recoil, victory and defeat. All nine actual techniques inspected front and side; front legs thrust out while torso shifts and support soles slide or sink. Independent original sole maximum drift attack 0.38791, cast 0.29340, recoil 0.20097, floor penetration as much as 0.09215. Head/neck sole contribution is zero, confirming a negative influence screen misses contact failures. Tail and dorsal spikes remain connected; preserve their sculpt and authored motion. Separate face and fitted-limb candidate numerical checks pass but candidate images not yet inspected.
